description:
Kogane Midori is a sencha with a golden leaf, offered as the product of a single plantation in Shizuoka. The name reads roughly as golden green, and the colour is the point: sencha is normally deep green.

Little is documented beyond that. Whether it is a registered cultivar, and how the colour comes about, is not clearly recorded, so treat it as a rarity rather than a known style.

Brew it as a fine sencha, with water around 70 C, and taste before deciding. A striking leaf does not promise a striking cup.

It comes in small, expensive packs. Ask for the harvest year, and buy a little first.
history: Little is documented about who selected this plant or when. It is known from retail listings that describe it as a golden sencha grown at a single Shizuoka plantation, and its origin is otherwise unrecorded.
